market.question: Will the highest temperature in Seattle be between 76-77°F on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: NWS-style forecast for Seattle May 3 shows high near 70°F. Hitting the narrow 76-77°F bucket would require ~6-7°F above forecast — well into the tail; probability ~5-10%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Marine layer breakdown and offshore flow could push temps higher than expected
